description: Merge the mission's open pull request on GitHub with the repository's own merge method; the mission then becomes done, and the merge cannot be undone from here. Answers 409 with the reason when the pull request cannot merge. On a merge conflict SHIP starts the builder to fix it and merges once the mission is ready again, with no further call. Requires the missions:write scope.

issueId.description: The mission's issue id: a Linear key or a GitHub Issues id, e.g. SHIP-412

name: merge_mission
title: Merge a mission's pull request
